blocks.raw: The `jolt_transform` block applies a JOLT transformation to JSON data as a transformation block in a Connect+ dataflow. [JOLT](https://github.com/bazaarvoice/jolt) is an open-source JSON-to-JSON transformation library that uses a JSON-based specification to define how input JSON is restructured or mapped. The block accepts a JOLT specification that defines how the input JSON is restructured or mapped before being passed to downstream blocks.
blocks.text: The jolt_transform block applies a JOLT transformation to JSON data as a transformation block in a Connect+ dataflow. JOLT is an open-source JSON-to-JSON transformation library that uses a JSON-based specification to define how input JSON is restructured or mapped. The block accepts a JOLT specification that defines how the input JSON is restructured or mapped before being passed to downstream blocks.

blocks.raw: Use this block when your dataflow needs to reshape a JSON payload using a JOLT specification — for example, when integrating with systems that require a specific JSON schema.
blocks.text: Use this block when your dataflow needs to reshape a JSON payload using a JOLT specification — for example, when integrating with systems that require a specific JSON schema.

blocks.raw: Before configuring this block, make sure you have:

* A sample of the input JSON to validate your specification
